items.text: Keio University, Tokyo (degree in the history of aesthetics; studied fine arts and literature)

items.title: Rei Kawakubo/Comme des Garçons: Art of the In-Between
items.venue: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (Costume Institute), New York
Independent Art Fair, New York (installation of rebar and plastic with 20 designs)

items.text: Worked in the advertising department of Asahi Kasei, Tokyo
Began working as a freelance stylist
Opened first Comme des Garçons boutique, Tokyo
Began presenting collections in Paris each season
Launched Comme des Garçons Parfums with Adrian Joffe
Founded Dover Street Market, London (later Tokyo, Beijing, Singapore, New York and Los Angeles)
Chevalier de l'Ordre des Arts et des Lettres, France
Officer of the Ordre national du Mérite, France
Lifetime Achievement Medal, London Design Festival
